title: Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate
title_zh: TrueMAD——面向多智能体辩论的针对性同伴互动方法

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种新的多智能体辩论方法TrueMAD，通过引入一对一的同伴互动机制，提升大语言模型的推理能力。 Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为 TrueMAD 的多智能体辩论新方法，通过引入一对一的同伴互动机制，提升大语言模型的推理能力。多智能体辩论（MAD）旨在通过让智能体接触替代解决方案并支持迭代修正，来改善大语言模型的推理能力。 然而，标准的广播式 MAD 虽然使同伴的答案可见，却并未要求智能体针对特定同伴的主张进行互动。 因此，可靠的推理可能会被相互冲突或占多数意见的回应所压制，从而限制可达到的性能；而错误的推理则可能在缺乏可操作反馈的情况下持续存在，并降低最终预测的质量。 我们提出了 TrueMAD——一种与模型架构无关的测试时插件，它在答案广播与自我修正之间引入了自由形式的一对一同伴建议机制。 每个源智能体通过支持、反驳、完善或提出进一步问题来回应目标智能体的当前推理，而目标智能体仍保留对如何修正自身推理的控制权。 同一机制无需更新模型参数，即可增强标准 MAD 及其改进版本。 在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond 和 TruthfulQA（使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B）数据集上，TrueMAD 的智能体级别准确率和严格多数准确率平均分别比 MAD 提升了 3.62 和 3.52 个百分点；而 TrueDMAD 则分别使 DMAD 的准确率提升了 4.72 和 4.06 个百分点。 在话语、智能体转换和群体层面上的进一步分析表明，该方法促进了更具同伴针对性的审议过程、更多以修正为导向的调整，以及更积极的共识形成动态。
